messages:
Maya R: Quick sync: propose a clear matching policy for provisional claims emitted when ingest lags. Core idea: require provenance_id from edge; fallback to fingerprint but mark fallback so reconcile is more conservative.

Kevin L: Agree on provenance_id. If fallback used we should widen reconcile window (e.g., 7d) and avoid auto-commit to prevent false matches.

Priya S: Console UX: show a "matched by: provenance|fallback" column and a short tooltip explaining risk. Also let billing ops filter to only fallback matches.

Diego R: API change summary: billing events add provisional:boolean, provenance_id:string, match_type:provenance|fingerprint, estimate_tokens:int, provisional_ttl:int. Reconcile endpoint should accept action=commit|adjust|void and be idempotent.

Alex H: Rollout plan: feature-flagged per-tenant billing.matching.v1. Canary 20 tenants, monitor reconcile_delta_pct and false_match_rate. If fallback false_match_rate > 0.5% rollback fallback for that tenant.

Kevin L: Metrics to emit: billing.provisional_emitted_total, billing.provisional_match_fallback_total, billing.provisional_reconcile_delta_pct_p95, billing.provisional_false_match_rate. Alert if reconcile_delta_pct_p95 > 3% or false_match_rate > 0.5% for 30m.

Priya S: For console exports, hide provisional lines by default and add an "Include provisional" checkbox for internal exports. Also add audit trail when ops force-commit with justification text.

billing-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed billing-service v2.20.0 to staging with billing.matching.v1=false.

Maya R: I'll draft the design doc and PRs for schema + console changes, will include test plan for split-final events. Tagging @Kevin L @Priya S for review.
